subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Haste
solution:
The correct answer is: Hurry

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Haste means speed in doing something, especially because you do not have enough time.

 
 
• Example - *It was obvious that the letter had been written in **haste**.*
 
 
 
• *​*Marked option Hurry means to move or do something quickly because there is not much time.
 
 
• Example - *Take your time. There’s no **hurry**.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Haste' and 'Hurry' are similar in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Leisure means the time when you do not have to work; free time.
 
• Delay means the act of postponing, hindering, or causing something to occur more slowly than normal.
 
• Rest means a period of relaxing, sleeping or doing nothing.
